NTS Stainless Steel Fabrication products are custom-engineered solutions designed to meet the specific requirements of professional kitchens, restaurants, hotels, and food processing facilities. These made-to-order products combine superior craftsmanship with premium food-grade stainless steel to deliver equipment that perfectly fits your space and operational needs. Each fabrication project undergoes rigorous quality control to ensure precise dimensions, flawless welding, and impeccable finishing that meets international food safety standards. Our experienced fabricators work closely with clients to transform concepts into functional, durable equipment that enhances workflow efficiency and maintains the highest hygiene standards. The use of grade 304 stainless steel ensures exceptional corrosion resistance, easy cleaning, and long-lasting performance in demanding commercial environments. From custom work tables to specialized sinks, exhaust hoods, and storage solutions, every product is tailored to exact specifications while maintaining structural integrity and aesthetic appeal. Our work tables feature a knock-down design for easy transportation and installation, reducing shipping costs and simplifying on-site assembly. The modular design approach allows for future modifications and expansions, protecting your investment as your business grows. All fabricated products feature smooth, crevice-free surfaces that prevent bacterial growth and facilitate thorough sanitization.



General Technical Specifications

  • Material: Food-grade stainless steel 304 (SS304) construction
  • Thickness: Various gauges available (1.0mm - 2.0mm standard)
  • Finish: Brushed or polished finish options
  • Welding: TIG welded joints with smooth finishing
  • Support: Reinforced frames and adjustable legs
  • Assembly: Knock-down design available for work tables
  • Customization: Fully customizable dimensions and configurations
  • Accessories: Optional backsplashes, undershelves, and drawers
  • Load Capacity: Engineered to support heavy commercial use
  • Compliance: Meets NSF and food safety standards

• Sycloid® Toasters
  • Elegantly designed and crafted, the revolutionary Sycloid® toaster sets the standard for high speed toast production.

  • Features:
    • Available in red, black or natural colours with the option of either 10 amps producing over 350* slices per hour, or 13 amps, producing over 500* slices per hour.
    • All Sycloid toasters deliver excellent toasting results for bread up to 30 mm thickness. As most bread used in buffets is expected to be less than 20 mm thickness, the Sycloid is optimised to deliver its best result for bread of this thickness, and can accommodate slices up to 30 mm.
    • Patron and staff safety is paramount and the Sycloid® toaster has been designed with “cool to touch” external surfaces and a lid locking latch.
    • Intelligent energy efficient design – an automatic energy-save mode conserves energy during quiet periods by scaling back power consumption and switching off the conveyor when in energy save mode. The intelligent auto-sense feature detects when a new slice of bread is placed in the machine and automatically prepares the machine to toast the bread. The heat setting in this mode is balanced and optimised to ensure quick recovery. Energy save mode can be disabled so the machine runs at full power if desired.
    • A user-friendly and reliable speed controller allows adjustment of the toasting time to account for different types of bread to be toasted. The knob setting lock feature allows staff to set the toasting speed, removing the risk of patrons altering the setting.
    • Diners can easily see when their toast is ready from across the buffet with the stylishly sculpted toast return chute with LED lighting that provides easy and illuminated viewing of the toast holding bay. The wide opening of the bay allows easy access to toast, which the radiant heat from the elements helps to keep warm.
    • Featuring robust stainless steel elements, the Sycloid® toaster also features a modern brushed stainless steel exterior, perfect for disguising finger prints on a machine expected to be heavily used. It also includes a slide-out crumb tray for everyday cleaning and a hinged top cover allowing easy access to clean the inside.
    • The Sycloid® toaster produces a beautiful toasting result throughout the entire slice of bread.

  • The oven is fully insulated on all four sides and top with high temperature insulation.

  • Ovens can be ordered for 208VAC,240VAC, 230VAC, 380VAC or 400
  • VAC electrical utilities.

  • Heating is accomplished with four (4)infrared emitters.
  • Two infrared emitters are located above and below the conveyor belt.
  • When food product is placed on the conveyor belt, it cooks as it passes between the top and bottom emitters.

  • The oven is controlled by a microprocessor, which includes a time/date clock for automatic turn “ON” and turn “OFF”, an energyconserving standby mode.

  • Other Features:
    • Standard pan thickness – 0.6mm 18/8 AISI.304 stainless steel construction.
    • Perforated pans available in 1/1 & ½ size.
    • Gastronorm pans (0.8mm thickness, European compliant) available in 1/1 & ½ size. Pan body sized to meet the standard for steam table pans.
    • Cross bars available to support fractional sizes.
    • Stylish lids with recess to return condensation to pan and designed to stack.
    • Perforated pans available in certain sizes.
    • Stainless steel lids to suit all pan sizes.
